entries.name: sdv-add-cbs-league
entries.purpose: Add a CBS Sports (NAPI) league/resource — capture + catalog in sdv-internal-refs/cbs.

entries.name: sdv-add-espn-league
entries.purpose: Register a new ESPN league family in sdv-py — leagues.yaml row, pre-create package dir + __init__, regenerate, gated live test, verify the drift gate.

entries.name: sdv-add-fox-league
entries.purpose: Add a Fox Sports (Bifrost) league/sport — capture + catalog in sdv-internal-refs/fox.

entries.name: sdv-add-provider-source
entries.purpose: Add a league/source for ANY SportsDataverse provider (ESPN, Fox Bifrost, CBS NAPI, Yahoo, 247Sports, Torvik) — capture bodies, generate the returns doc, extend the catalog, scaffold the wrapper.

entries.name: sdv-add-sport-parser
entries.purpose: Add sport-specific tidy parsers for an ESPN sport (soccer/cricket pattern) — parser module + per-sport codegen routing + fixtures + TDD.

entries.name: sdv-add-yahoo-source
entries.purpose: Add a Yahoo Sports source — capture + catalog in sdv-internal-refs/yahoo (HTML/JSON scrape).

entries.name: sdv-capture-endpoint
entries.purpose: Hardened, provider-agnostic single-body capture for ESPN/Fox/CBS — structured id discovery, error-envelope skip, atomic writes.

entries.name: sdv-capture-oracle
entries.purpose: Use when capturing an external oracle/validation corpus into committed test fixtures — Torvik/KenPom ratings, ESPN BPI/predictor/odds, market closing lines, MoneyPuck, published RAPM/EPM, or any third-party reference a model gate will assert against.

entries.name: sdv-gen-returns-schema
entries.purpose: Generate a col_name|type|description returns table (Python schema YAML or R roxygen @return) from a sample payload or a live DataFrame's schema.

entries.name: sdv-model-spine
entries.purpose: Use when executing a model-spine implementation plan (the ClaudeCowork specs/plans backlog — prediction stacks, ratings engines, projection/impact models) or building any oracle-gated analytics module in an SDV repo.

entries.name: sdv-new-example-notebook
entries.purpose: Scaffold a per-sport intro Jupyter notebook (examples/notebooks/0X_<sport>_intro.ipynb).

entries.name: sdv-pkgdown-personalize
entries.purpose: Apply the bespoke SportsDataverse pkgdown theming and fix the shared extra.css Bootstrap-5 bugs (dark-mode-invisible text, dead .navbar-dark selectors).

entries.name: sdv-port
entries.purpose: Port logic between R, Python, and pandas/polars, parity-test-first against real fixtures.

entries.name: sdv-r-returns-table
entries.purpose: Generate or back-fill a roxygen @return markdown table (col_name|type|description) for an SDV R function, matching the Python returns convention.

entries.name: sdv-regen-docs
entries.purpose: Regenerate sdv-py reference docs, verify the Docusaurus build, and snapshot a versioned archive at release.

entries.name: sdv-ship
entries.purpose: Land a change: regen docs, preflight, commit, push, bot-triage, codegen gate, merge, stack retarget, release.

entries.name: anomaly-triage-reviewer
entries.purpose: Use to triage a `sweep` WARN finding from the sdv-py validation harness — judge whether a null-rate spike or mean-shift vs the prior release is a real regression or an expected data change.

entries.name: docstring-auditor
entries.purpose: Use to audit Python docstring completeness/quality in sdv-py — flags public callables missing Google-style napoleon Args/Returns/Raises/Example or See-Also blocks, and any raw >>> doctest prompts.

entries.name: espn-parser-contract-reviewer
entries.purpose: Use after adding/editing an ESPN parser in sdv-py to verify the universal parser contract and ENDPOINT_PARSERS coverage.

entries.name: extraction-semantics-reviewer
entries.purpose: Use to triage an `extraction` WARN finding from the sdv-py validation harness — judge whether a low-coverage extracted column is a real parser bug or a legitimately-null field for that play type.

entries.name: http-layer-reviewer
entries.purpose: Use when changing sdv-py network code (dl_utils.download, capture/crawl tooling) to verify the retry/pooling/backoff/bounding conventions.

entries.name: leakage-reviewer
entries.purpose: Use to triage a `leakage_lint` (Python/R source) or `boundary_leakage` (cumulative-non-reset) WARN finding from the sdv-py validation harness — judge whether a lag/cumulative op is a real cross-game data leak or a benign / already-grouped case.

entries.name: oracle-gate-reviewer
entries.purpose: Use before merging new model/validation code (a model-spine phase, a ratings engine, a backtest, a simulator) to audit its correctness contract — distinct from the Tier-2 validation agents, which triage harness WARN findings on existing datasets.

entries.name: parity-divergence-reviewer
entries.purpose: Use to triage a `numeric_parity` WARN finding from the sdv-py validation harness — judge whether a column's correlation below its oracle floor is a real model/producer regression or a documented, acceptable divergence.

entries.name: polars-1x-reviewer
entries.purpose: Use after writing/editing polars code in sdv-py to keep it current with the installed polars (lockfile resolves to 1.42; pin >=1.0,<2.0; review floor 1.2+).

entries.name: port-parity-reviewer
entries.purpose: Use after porting a module between R and Python (either direction — nflfastR/cfbfastR/hoopR/wehoop/bigballR ↔ sdv-py, or a TS/Scala source like the hoop-explorer port) to audit the ported code for the recurring cross-language bug classes and verify parity-test coverage.

entries.name: provider-shape-mapper
entries.purpose: Use to map a captured provider payload (ESPN/Fox/CBS/Yahoo) into documentation — produces a top-level-key table, a col_name|type|description returns table, and divergence-vs-sibling notes.

entries.name: returns-table-auditor
entries.purpose: Use to audit returns-schema coverage and quality across sdv-py + the R packages — finds functions/endpoints missing a col_name|type|description returns table, schema columns with empty descriptions, and endpoint YAMLs that declare a parser but no returns_schema.

entries.name: roxygen-doc-reviewer
entries.purpose: Use to review SportsDataverse R package documentation — checks roxygen completeness (@param/@return table/@examples) and _pkgdown.yml reference coverage.

entries.name: sdv-data-pipeline
entries.purpose: Producer lifecycle for -raw/-data repos: standardize, placement, scrape, build, validate, publish.
